name: singlet_clustering_hierarchical_cluster_tree
title: Hierarchical tree of cell clusters
description: Builds a tree over the groups of an existing obs column from centroid distances in an embedding, then writes the linkage, a Newick tree, centroid distances and cut labels at chosen cluster counts. Use it to describe how populations split and merge; it does not show that a split is real or a lineage. Needs an obs group column and an obsm embedding. Cell-level trees are not supported in this version.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

groupby.description: obs column whose categories are the tree leaves; use an unsupervised partition when labels will be scored.

method.description: Centroid distance and linkage: Ward (default), correlation with complete linkage, or Euclidean with complete linkage.

use_rep.description: obsm key of the embedding from which group centroids are computed.

n_pcs.description: Leading components of use_rep to use; null uses all of them.

cut_ks.description: Cluster counts for cut labels; pass the expert-label count when a reference exists.

name.description: Prefix for written members, for example uns/hierarchy/linkage.

seed.description: Random seed for persistence subsamples; unused when persistence.n_bootstrap is 0.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA only for large distance matrices or persistence.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

persistence.description: Split persistence under cell subsampling; disabled by default.

n_bootstrap.description: Number of subsample trees; 0 disables persistence.

subsample_fraction.description: Fraction of cells per subsample, drawn without replacement.

threshold.description: Fraction of subsample trees in which a clade must appear to count as persistent.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: tree and labels written; dry_run: estimate only; queued: persistence running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example uns/hierarchy/linkage and obs/hierarchy_cut_10. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, n_leaves, monotone (merge heights non-decreasing), cut_sizes, and persistence when requested.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
